title: Storage Fabric locality and source-identity acceptance fence
summary: A resident-MU seek request carries an immutable StorageRef, stream/channel, sample extent, target rate, and method identity. C local source guard records device/inode/extent/mode plus nanosecond mtime/ctime on open and rejects catalogue/decode success if changed. This guard is only metadata mutation detection; durable source digest/lease validation remains a Storage Fabric responsibility.
invariants: Do not transfer original 1 GiB Ogg or unbounded PCM across Storage Fabric on repeated seek calls.
Source file mutations observed during a seek must reject and delete partially created private output and report.
Metadata equality is not cryptographic identity and does not prevent same-size invisible modifications; StorageRef digest and immutable revision must be independently enforced.
Do not assume that file size/local path alone binds identity across MUs or replicas.
A 64 MiB per-request compressed-read default is a cap, not a performance certification; record bytes per seek and reject overruns.
Source-fence C fixture passing does not qualify Ogg seeking, multitrack, chained segments or audio enhancement.
Autobuilder publishes a new immutable package path only on successful receipt; do not claim acceptance from an unmerged PR or a ready Git marker.
procedure: Use source residency resolution to bind the original StorageRef to a local read-only regular file FD on its owning MU.
Check a durable source digest/version through Storage Fabric policy before and after the job where required.
At native provider start capture fstat device/inode/size/mode/mtime/ctime; at completion compare before declaring success.
Record compressed bytes fetched, seek calls, sample count and PTS/jitter in private receipts; publish only compact source-linked derivative references.
Test fixture with sh tests/run_source_fence.sh under GCC -Werror; additionally qualify real Ogg provider end to end on the source host.

provenance.claim: Local mutation/identity regression; no media data.
Git submission branch ready marker and immutable publication contract.
